description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk.
When the token Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Progenitor Mimic
uses.cardState: as a copy of Pinnacle Monk
